label: halo ring
construction: A halo ring: one continuous shank; a single center stone in a prong or bezel setting; a single ring of small accent stones encircling the center stone, each accent stone seated in shared prongs or beads; the halo joined to the setting and the shank.
photo: Studio product photograph, soft even lighting, white seamless background, subtle shadow, the ring fills the frame, no text, no people, no props.
views: three-quarter view showing the halo, center stone, and shank
top-down view of the center stone and halo

checks.question: Are there one center stone surrounded by one continuous ring of small accent stones?
Is every stone visibly held by prongs, a bezel, or channel walls that are part of the metal, with no stone floating?
Is the shank one continuous band joined to the setting?
